output_schema.description: One retained action trace, or the reason it is not available.

tools.purpose: Read back the retained diagnostic timeline for one action by its trace_id: lifecycle milestones, structured exceptions, the event window it spanned, the baseline and final UI projection, the expected-postcondition result, and best-effort native log matches. Every action response carries a trace_id. An expired trace returns found=false with the retention window. Returns a summary by default; pass detail='full' for the event list, projection delta and log lines.

tools.purpose: Start browse mode for a document NVDA is reading in focus mode, the way NVDA+space does, and report the implementation that now answers. The reading tools need this: Word and some PDF readers keep documents in focus mode until asked, so list_reading_targets and navigate_reading refuse until a model exists. Changes the user's session; 'created' is false when one was already there, so asking twice is harmless.
